notes.title: We are the Plague - Patch #1 is now live!
notes.notes:
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/11464454/1cf537c56bf3a83530037f8e35ce3666ee9a350d.jpg

A new patch for We are the Plague on Steam is now live! We've listened to your feedback and the first batch of fixes and improvements is waiting for you - make sure your game is up to date!

PATCH NOTE:
- No more camping guys! Now the chance for a counter-attack when defending is lowered to 30% (previously 100%)
- Any collectors here? We added achievements for you!
- Check out the new snazzy summary screen with convenient improvements.
- Added some minor bug fixes

notes.title: Roll'd update
notes.notes:
Greetings fellow Rollers,
 
This first update to Roll’d has arrived and with it a brand new theme: Ohayo.
 
Golden week might be over, but today we will take you on a roll to the Land of the Rising Sun:
 
-Run through the 4 new levels: the peaceful Edo countryside, the raging ocean with mount Fuji slowly observing you in the background, the Sakura season in full bloom and a snowstorm in a mountain range Fort.  
-Check out the 4 new runners and return of one kawaii favourite.  
-Level cap raised to 59
-Fixes to the leaderboards: now scores will display correctly across all levels
 
Hope to se you rolling soon. Yoi ichininichi o!
